## What changed and why

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks performed and any limitations. Include clean demo screenshots for UI changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No credentials, private data, runtime stores, or generated installers are included.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass and changed behavior is covered where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible changes.
- [ ] Existing local data, provider permissions, and approvals are preserved.
